title: Fungicides

review.classification: Single registered wettable-powder product, distinct from technical material, other preparations, herbicides and veterinary or field services. The official CPC leaf remains 34662 even though a public native dataset titled Mancozeb is classified under 34669 by that dataset.
review.primary_evidence: Original same-holder label PD20091282, Chinese product-qualification record rules and national standard metadata independently support the product and first-release gates. Other-holder labels corroborate product form only. No actual manufacturer batch, output rate, supplier inventory or foreground quantities are inferred from them.
review.measurement: First commercial release counts unique net finished product mass within its reporting pool. Retail resale, replacement packaging, custody changes and reinspection of previously released stock create no new Q. The net denominator excludes all packaging; the labelled 70% is not a conversion to active-substance-equivalent kg. Preserve raw inventories for zero release. Check stocks and disjoint destinations before one normalization and require supplier/foreground scope to match. Controller probe for a separately borrowed package: opening 0, externally carried remaining burden 5, newly incurred 0, assigned 2, closing carried 3. Final product and packaging ledgers include external inherited vectors, individual keys and paired outward settlements. The same exchange receives no second production charge. Separate inward returns of a previously released product from its return to an upstream supplier, as verified in 17 distinct card IDs per language. Neither movement creates a new first-release denominator.
review.native_records: Both independently read Mancozeb Product versions describe generic plant production and carry 34669 in their classification. Neither identifies the registered whole 70% finished product. Mass → mass units → kg and metered Energy → energy units are independently verifiable. Utility provider/context and exact whole product UUID require site/lot evidence.
review.readiness: Candidate/authored_methodology, English canonical and Chinese aligned. Scientific and independent translation approval and publication remain pending. A completed foreground dataset needs actual original lot, qualified site and first event, matched upstream black-box coverage, package BOM, meters, residuals and relevant service data.

sources.role: Original ICAMA header identifies the same holder, branded registration identity, grade and wettable-powder form, distinguishing a whole formulated product from technical material. It supplies no first release, period permission or environmental quantity.

2022 consolidated edition. State Council pesticide regulation, articles 19, 21 and 22. Recognises licensed contract packaging, quality and certificate for release for factory sale, traceable product/batch/quantity/sale records, and packaging/labels. Factory approval and later sale or custody movement are different accounting events.
Official current product standard metadata and the identities of superseded separate standards for technical material and wettable powder. Edition depends on study date.
Original CPC3 row 1496 cites HS 3808.92 for 34662. The registered fungicide falls within this leaf, separate from residual 34669.

European Commission environmental footprint method supports defining units, system boundaries, reuse and allocation. Does not supply this product’s inventory, a product-specific PEFCR or scientific approval.
